summary: Frontend-only verification of the Allergies / Chronic Conditions comma-stripping bug fix on both New Patient (create) and Patient Profile (edit). The primary bug is FIXED and all core scenarios pass. Commas are now retained while typing, and the values are correctly parsed into arrays only on save. Badges render properly on the patient profile.

test_scenarios_executed.name: NEW PATIENT - typing comma-separated Allergies/Chronic
test_scenarios_executed.details: Typed 'Penicillin, Aspirin, Sulfa' into patient-allergies-input and 'Hypertension, Diabetes' into patient-chronic-input character-by-character. Values retained verbatim (input.value == typed string). After submit at /patients/new, patient profile rendered Penicillin, Aspirin, Sulfa badges and Hypertension, Diabetes badges (each text appeared once as separate badge).

test_scenarios_executed.name: EDIT PATIENT - prefill + append comma
test_scenarios_executed.details: Clicked edit-patient-btn on created patient. edit-patient-allergies-input pre-filled 'Penicillin, Aspirin, Sulfa'; edit-patient-chronic-input pre-filled 'Hypertension, Diabetes'. Typed ', Latex' at end of allergies -> value became 'Penicillin, Aspirin, Sulfa, Latex' with all commas intact. Save succeeded (PUT /api/patients/{id}).

test_scenarios_executed.name: REGRESSION - empty allergies/chronic
test_scenarios_executed.details: Created a patient leaving both textareas empty. Registration succeeded (redirected to /patients/{id}). Profile shows 'Allergies: None' and 'Chronic Conditions: None' with no errors.

test_scenarios_executed.name: REGRESSION - single entry no comma
test_scenarios_executed.details: Not explicitly executed in browser due to test-script assertion aborting the block (unrelated: hardcoded localStorage token key mismatch in a probe fetch), but code-review confirms handleSubmit uses split(',').map(trim).filter(Boolean) which for input 'Peanuts' yields ['Peanuts']. Low risk.

code_review_findings: NewPatientPage.js: allergies/chronic_conditions now stored as raw strings in formData, parsed via split/trim/filter only in handleSubmit — correct fix.
PatientProfilePage.js: allergiesText/chronicText local state seeded on Edit click via (patient.allergies || []).join(', '), parsed on Save — correct fix.
Both textareas now bind value directly to the string state, no on-keystroke split/filter. Commas persist during typing.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and targeted — good separation between input state (string) and persisted state (List[str]).
Consider also stripping duplicates on save (currently 'Aspirin, Aspirin' would save both) — minor UX improvement, not a blocker.
test_credentials: Trial + doctor account created dynamically per run (trial{ts}@test.com / doc{ts}@test.com / Passw0rd!). Note: page.reload() breaks the license/session because the encrypted device-bound license state is held in memory; use client-side history navigation (pushState + popstate) to move between routes in tests.
seed_data_creation: Two test patients created: 'Comma Test Patient' (with Penicillin/Aspirin/Sulfa/Latex + Hypertension/Diabetes), 'Empty Allergies Patient' (empty arrays).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comma bug in Allergies / Chronic Conditions is fixed and verified on both create and edit flows. If retesting, avoid page.reload() — it resets the LicenseContext in-memory state and shows the trial gate again. Use pushState/popstate for client-side navigation to stay authenticated within a session.
rca of the issue: Original bug: onChange did `value.split(',').filter(Boolean).map(s => s.trim())` and stored an array; on next render the string was rebuilt as `arr.join(', ')` — but the just-typed trailing comma was filtered out before render, so users could never type a comma. Fix: keep raw string in state during editing; only split/trim/filter when submitting/saving.
